title: 第6章 弃医从文
content_zh:
屋内，随着李凖的话陷入了一片寂静。李凖扫视一圈，见王爱梅和刘振国沉默不言，正主更是一脸尴尬，便知道自己找错了切入口。

    “嗨呀，没什么大不了的。”李凖赶紧扯了一个话题，跟刘振国聊起了水利岁月。

    燕影厂准备拍摄《大河奔流》，这部电影改编自李凖的小说。只不过小说写于十年期间，缺少了许多东西，如教员和ZL的片段。

    这本小说在74年时，就被选中了。但是因为燕影厂拍摄的《海霞》遭到四人棒攻击，主创的创作权利被剥夺，就搁置了下来。

    《大河奔流》这部小说讲的是抗日战争期间，光头为了阻滞日军进攻的脚步，命人炸开了黄河。迟滞了日军进攻脚步的同时，滔天洪水的肆虐下，一千两百万百姓流离失所，死伤惨重。

    花园口决堤，给中原人民造成了沉重的苦难，直到1946年黄河封堤。长达八年九个月的时间里，黄河持续泛滥，黄泛区的面积覆盖豫皖苏三省，44个县，面积达五点四万平方公里。

    民国河南救济署报告里写道：“漫流走沙，愈演愈大，一片荒烟，到处凄凉……古人云，‘鸟飞不下，兽挺亡群’，‘田原荒芜，庐舍为墟’，用之泛区不惟不甚，且只能道其十之二三……昔日中原乐土，今时人间地狱。”“百里不见炊烟起，唯有飞沙扑空城。无径荒草狐兔跑，泽国芦苇蛤蟆鸣”。

    新中国成立后，中央成立了黄泛区复兴委员会，一边治理黄河，一边发展黄泛区农场。

    这部小说以黄泛区几户农民的遭遇，串联起了这二十年的历史，展现了战争和灾害造成的沉重苦难以及新中国成立后的艰难治理历程。

    燕影厂如今对《大河奔流》的改编要求更高，要求呈现更多真实细节，脱离“高大全”，以细节打动观众。

    刘振国参加过黄泛区治理，之后又修建过三门峡水利枢纽，在工地上还见过ZL，是理想的采访对象。

    李凖对刘振国的经历非常感兴趣，听到重要的地方，还会拿出笔记下来。

    刘济民一边吃饭，一边听刘振国讲经历。讲到自豪的地方，刘振国便斜睨刘济民一眼，似乎是想告诉刘济民，“看你老子当年多厉害！”。

    刘济民适时发出不同音调的感叹声，配合得天衣无缝。

    “刘老师，能不能细讲一下ZL当时的神态。”李凖拿出笔记本，认真地说道。

    “很有威仪，但并不高高在上，而是平易近人。眼神慈祥，看到大家吃窝窝头，眼里透露着心疼。ZL走后没多久，我们的伙食就大变样了。”刘振国夹着烟停顿了一下，“他一直在想能为我们做点什么，说话声音不大，但不说空话。”

    陈凖点了点头，迅速记了下来。

    王爱梅让两人赶紧吃，等吃完了再聊正事也来得及，饺子凉了就不好吃了。
content_en:
In the room, silence fell into silence following Li Xun's words. Li Xuan glanced around and saw that Wang Aimei and Liu Zhenguo were silent, and the principal looked embarrassed, so he knew that he had found the wrong entry point.

    "Hey, it's not a big deal." Li Xuan quickly changed the topic and chatted with Liu Zhenguo about the years of water conservancy.

    Yan Film Studio is preparing to shoot "The River Runs", which is adapted from Li Zhen's novel. It's just that the novel was written during ten years, and many things are missing, such as fragments of the teacher and the leader.

    This novel was selected in 1974. However, because "Haixia" filmed by Yan Film Studio was attacked by four people, the creative rights of the main creator were deprived, so it was shelved.

    The novel "The River Runs" tells the story of Baldhead who ordered people to blow up the Yellow River during the Anti-Japanese War in order to block the Japanese attack. While slowing down the Japanese offensive, 12 million people were displaced due to the raging floods, resulting in heavy casualties.

    The Huayuankou embankment burst caused heavy suffering to the people of the Central Plains until the Yellow River embankment was sealed in 1946. For eight years and nine months, the Yellow River continued to flood. The Yellow River flood area covered 44 counties in the three provinces of Henan, Anhui and Jiangsu, covering an area of ​​54,000 square kilometers.

    The report of the Henan Relief Administration of the Republic of China wrote: "The overflowing sand is getting bigger and bigger, and it is a piece of desolate smoke, and it is desolate everywhere... The ancients said, 'birds can't fly, and beasts die in flocks', 'fields are barren, and houses are ruins', which is used loosely. Not only is the area not very detailed, but it can only be described as twenty-three percent of it... The former paradise of the Central Plains is now a hell on earth. "There is no smoke for a hundred miles, only flying sand flying over the empty city. There are no pathless grass, foxes and rabbits running, and the reeds in the country are buzzing."

    After the founding of the People's Republic of China, the central government established the Yellow River Flood Area Revitalization Committee to regulate the Yellow River while developing farms in the Yellow River Flood Area.

    This novel connects the history of the past two decades through the experiences of several farmers in the Huangfan District, showing the heavy suffering caused by wars and disasters as well as the difficult governance process after the founding of New China.

    Yan Film Studio now has higher requirements for the adaptation of "The River Runs", requiring more real details to be presented, breaking away from the "high-end", and impressing the audience with details.

    Liu Zhenguo participated in the management of the Yellow River Flood Area, and later built the Sanmenxia Water Conservancy Project. He also met ZL on the construction site, making him an ideal interview subject.

    Li Zhen was very interested in Liu Zhenguo's experience. He would take out notes and write down important points when he heard them.

    While Liu Jimin was eating, he listened to Liu Zhenguo talk about his experiences. When he talked about being proud, Liu Zhenguo glanced sideways at Liu Jimin, as if he wanted to tell Liu Jimin, "Look how powerful you were back then!".

    Liu Jimin sighed with different tones at the right time, and the coordination was perfect.

    "Teacher Liu, can you tell me more about ZL's demeanor at that time." Li Yan took out his notebook and said seriously.

    "Very majestic, but not condescending, but approachable. His eyes are kind, and his eyes show distress when he sees everyone eating steamed buns. Not long after ZL left, our food changed drastically." Liu Zhenguo paused while holding a cigarette, "He has been thinking about what he can do for us. He speaks in a low voice, but does not make empty words."

    Chen Xuan nodded and quickly wrote it down.

    Wang Aimei asked the two of them to eat quickly. It would be too late to talk about business after they finished eating. The dumplings would not taste good when they were cold.
